title: Assert account_picker_local_data_missing_test.dart's expected SnackBar text via the l10n getter, not a hardcoded English literal
rule: Test-fragility / consistency with sibling tests in this batch

evidence.quote:
'This account\'s local data is missing. '
        'Connect to the internet to restore it.',

why: Both C1 and C2 hardcode the expected SnackBar copy as an English literal instead of asserting against `l10n.authLocalDataMissing` the way sign_in_wrong_password_no_callback_test.dart (same batch) asserts against `l10n.authErrWrongPassword`. A future copy edit to the ARB string breaks this test for a cosmetic reason indistinguishable, in the failure output, from an actual regression in the local-data-missing handling logic.
recommendation: Load AppLocalizations in the test (as done elsewhere in this batch) and assert find.text(l10n.authLocalDataMissing) instead of the literal string.
acceptance_criteria: C1/C2 assert against l10n.authLocalDataMissing rather than a literal string.
